title: Argus Security Scanner Configuration
description: Configuration schema for argus.yml — the Argus security scanning pipeline. Docs: https://huntridge-labs.github.io/argus/

version.description: Configuration schema version. Currently only '1.0' is supported.

scanners.description: Scanner configurations. Each key is a scanner name (e.g. bandit, gitleaks, osv) mapped to its settings.

severityLevel.description: Severity threshold level. Findings at or above this level trigger a failure.

enabled.description: Whether this scanner is active. Disabled scanners are skipped during 'argus scan'.

path.description: Path to scan, relative to the repository root.

severity_threshold.description: Per-scanner severity threshold. Overrides the reporting-level threshold for this scanner.

config_file.description: Path to a scanner-specific configuration file (e.g. pyproject.toml for Bandit, .checkov.yaml for Checkov).

exclude.description: Comma-separated list of paths or patterns to exclude from this scanner's analysis.

image_ref.description: Container image reference for container scanning (e.g. 'myapp:latest').

target_url.description: URL of the target application for DAST scanning (e.g. 'http://localhost:3000').

scanners.description: Comma-separated list of sub-scanners for container scanning (e.g. 'trivy,grype,syft').

registry_username.description: Username for private container registry authentication.

registry_password.description: Password or token for private container registry authentication. Prefer environment variables over hardcoding.

reportingConfig.description: Controls how scan results are formatted and where they are written.

formats.description: Output formats to generate. 'terminal' prints to stdout; others write files to output_dir.

severity_threshold.description: Global severity threshold. Findings at or above this level cause a non-zero exit code.

output_dir.description: Directory for scan result files (SARIF, JSON, Markdown reports).

executionConfig.description: Controls how scanner tools are executed — locally, in containers, or auto-detected.

backend.description: Execution backend. 'auto' prefers containers for reproducibility with local fallback. 'local' uses installed tools. 'docker' requires containers and fails if unavailable.

registry.description: Override the default container registry for private or air-gapped environments (e.g. 'registry.internal.corp/argus'). Flat host-swap — every image gets rewritten to '<registry>/<original-path>'. For setups where each proxy cache tracks a single upstream (Harbor / Artifactory / ECR), use 'registry_map' instead.

registry_map.description: Per-upstream registry mirrors. Keys are the upstream host (e.g. 'docker.io', 'ghcr.io', 'quay.io'); values are the mirror prefix to swap in. Wins over 'registry' on conflict. Unmapped upstreams fall through to 'registry' (if set) or the original reference. Recommended over 'registry' for Harbor / Artifactory / ECR proxy caches, which mirror a single upstream per project.

pull_policy.description: Container image pull policy. 'always' pulls on every run. 'if-not-present' uses cached images. 'never' requires pre-pulled images (for air-gapped environments).

containersConfig.description: Configuration for container image scanning via 'argus scan container'.

discover.description: Automatically discover Dockerfiles and build images for scanning.

search_paths.description: Directories to search for Dockerfiles when discover is enabled.

name.description: Human-readable name for this image in reports.

dockerfile.description: Path to the Dockerfile used to build this image.

images.description: Explicit list of container images to scan.

scanners.description: Sub-scanners to use for container analysis.

output_dir.description: Output directory for container scan results.

dastConfig.description: Configuration for dynamic application security testing (DAST) via 'argus scan zap'.

url.description: URL of an already-running web application to scan.

image.description: Container image to start and scan (Argus handles lifecycle).

name.description: Human-readable name for this target in reports.

port.description: Override the exposed port when using image-based targets.

env.description: Environment variables to pass to the target container.

targets.description: List of web application targets for DAST scanning.

scan_type.description: ZAP scan type. 'baseline' is faster and suitable for CI. 'full' performs deeper analysis.

startup_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a target container to become healthy before scanning.
